description: The paper discusses a basic SIR-type ordinary differential equation (ODE) model for cholera transmission, adapted from Codeço (2001). The model includes Susceptible (S), Infectious (I), and Recovered (R) human compartments, coupled with a compartment for the concentration of bacteria (B) in a water reservoir. The paper promises to show how this model can be modified to incorporate interventions like vaccination, treatment, and WASH, as well as concepts like waning immunity and asymptomatic infections.
